name: read_setting
summary: Read the current value of a curated, known-safe macOS preference (the same settings write_setting can change, e.g. whether Finder shows hidden files or the Dock auto-hides). Read-only: reports on/off/unset, changes nothing.

params.name: setting
params.description: Which curated setting to read. The same closed list write_setting can change.

name: set_appearance
summary: Switch the system-wide appearance between Dark and Light mode (the Appearance setting in System Settings). Reversible: undo restores the prior appearance. Uses System Events, so on first use macOS asks you to grant this app Automation access.

params.name: mode
params.description: The appearance to switch to: 'dark' for Dark mode, 'light' for Light mode.

name: write_setting
summary: Toggle a curated, known-safe macOS preference (e.g. show hidden files in Finder, auto-hide the Dock). Reversible: undo restores the prior value, or removes the key if it was unset.

params.name: setting
params.description: Which curated setting to change. Each is a well-known, reversible, non-security-relevant boolean toggle.

params.name: value
params.description: The new value: true to enable, false to disable.
